camel_example: aliyun imageenhan EnhanceImageColor --region cn-hangzhou --Mode LogC --OutputFormat png --ImageURL 'http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/viapi-3.0domepic/imageenhan/EnhanceImageColor/EnhanceImageColor1.jpg'
description_en: Describes the syntax and examples for the EnhanceImageColor operation in the image production (imageenhan) category
description_zh: 本文介绍图像生产（imageenhan）类目下的图像色彩增强EnhanceImageColor的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageenhan enhance-image-color --image-url http://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/viapi-3.0domepic/imageenhan/EnhanceImageColor/EnhanceImageColor1.jpg --output-format png --biz-mode LogC --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnhanceImageColor

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image. Use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored on your on-premises machine or in an OSS bucket in another region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Input limits:

Image format: JPG, PNG, or BMP.
Image size: Less than 3 MB.
Image resolution: Greater than 64 × 64 pixels and less than 3840 × 2160 pixels. The shortest side must be less than 2160 pixels, and the longest side must be less than 3840 pixels.
The URL cannot contain Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
输入限制：

图像格式：JPG、PNG、BMP。
图像大小：小于3 MB。
图像分辨率：大于64×64像素，小于3840×2160像素，最短边小于2160像素，最长边小于3840像素。
URL地址不能包含中文字符
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The output image format. Valid values: `png`, `jpg`, and `bmp`
parameters.help_zh: 输出的图片格式。取值范围：`png`、`jpg`、`bmp`
parameters.name: output_format

parameters.help_en:
The color grading mode. Valid values: LogC, Rec709, and ln17_256.

LogC: Suitable for flat images (low-contrast RAW images). It significantly adjusts the color perception of the image to restore the color texture of the SDR domain.
Rec709: Suitable for images captured under normal conditions. It moderately enhances image brightness and saturation with conservative adjustments.
ln17_256: Suitable for images captured under normal conditions. It significantly adjusts image brightness, saturation, and contrast to enhance color texture
parameters.help_zh:
调色模式。包括LogC、Rec709和ln17_256。

LogC：适用于灰片（低对比度raw图）输入，大幅度调整图像色彩观感，使其恢复SDR域的色彩质感。
Rec709：适用于一般条件拍摄的图像，适当提升图像亮度、饱和度等，调整幅度较为保守。
ln17_256：适用于一般条件拍摄的图像，大幅度调整图像亮度、饱和度、对比度，提升色彩质感
parameters.name: mode

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the processed image.
The URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. It becomes inaccessible after it expires. To retain the file for a long time or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
ImageURL.description_zh:
返回处理后的图像URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间
